name: allowlist_refined_grants_class
why: Allowlist with the read-only refinement and per-tool grants: argument constraints only (get_order, update_order), a fact that reads no argument (list_orders: call_depth), and a verb fact on a tool whose verb can come from its payload (query_run) and on one whose name fixes it (lookup_widget). tests/api/test_dryrun_replay.py classifies replays against it.
